notes: Recorded 6 bachelor rows (2 programmes plus 4 named specialisations or options) and 15 master rows (10 programmes plus 2 tracks of Sustainable Land Management and 3 majors of Marine and Lacustrine Science and Management). The call page states 12 programmes with scholarships; these are the 2 bachelors and 10 masters (Aquaculture, Food Technology, Marine and Lacustrine, Transportation Sciences, Nutrition and Food Systems, Sustainable Land Management and Tropical Biodiversity are initial masters; Development Evaluation, Globalisation and Governance are advanced masters).

The call page itself does not name the 12; it lists 20 programme pages in its menu. The 12 above were identified in the earlier pass and each page was re-read in this pass. Eight other VLIR-UOS programme pages exist (Agro- and Environmental Nematology, Rural Development (IMRD), Sustainable Development, Cultural Anthropology and Development Studies (CADES), Epidemiology, Human Settlements, Statistics and Data Science, Water Resources Engineering) and are not recorded because this call does not name them as scholarship programmes.
Marine and Lacustrine Science and Management: the VLIR-UOS page says four majors; the programme's own website names three (listed). The fourth was not found.
Aquaculture (IMAQUA): the page gives two years (120 ECTS) and also September 2027 to September 2028; the source does not resolve this.
not_stated: Specialisations or tracks for Aquaculture, Food Technology (two areas of emphasis are described but not as tracks), Nutrition and Food Systems, Transportation Sciences, Tropical Biodiversity, Development Evaluation (electives only), Globalisation and Development and Governance and Development.
fetch_problems: The programme sites run by the universities (Ghent, KU Leuven, Antwerp, Hasselt, VUB) were not read, only the VLIR-UOS pages and the Oceans and Lakes site.
